svg.title: Fig. 2(b) — The astroid as the envelope of ellipses of constant axis sum
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 2(b), page 2. Section: astroid.

g.data-text: The axes through O, and the constant a, the sum of the two semi-axes of every ellipse.
For each ellipse choose a semi-axis p on OX and take q = a − p on OY (p + q = a). Mark the four vertices ±p on OX and ±q on OY.
Through the four vertices of each pair draw the ellipse with its axes on OX and OY. Their sizes change by steps, from long and flat to tall and narrow.
The astroid touches every ellipse of the family: it is their envelope.
